name: Deskflow
author: Henning Futrell
description: Deskflow keyboard and mouse sharing, set up and controlled entirely from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Run Deskflow as client or server, set the server, place clients, and trust fingerprints without opening the Deskflow app.

schema.label: Mode
schema.description: auto follows the mode chosen in the Deskflow app. client receives keyboard and mouse from another machine; server shares this machine's keyboard and mouse.
